description: Bihar STET Computer Science Paper 2020 Re-Exam English Medium.

questions.questionText: A is the brother of B, C is the father of D, E is the mother of B, A and D are brothers. What is the relation of C with E?
questions.explanation: A and B are siblings. E is the mother of B (hence mother of A and B). A and D are brothers, so D is also E's child. C is the father of D, making C the husband of E. Thus, C is the husband and E is the wife, so the relation of C with E is Wife[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Ashok started to move in the direction of north. After moving 30m, he turned to his left and moved 40 m. Again he turned to his left and moved 30m. Now how far is he from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Ashok moves 30m North, turns left (West) and moves 40m, then turns left (South) and moves 30m. The net vertical displacement is zero, leaving him 40m away from the starting point[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: If CHAIR is coded in a symbolic language as 53269 and EAR as 729, then how will HEAR be coded?
questions.explanation: By direct letter-code mapping from CHAIR (5,3,2,6,9) and EAR (7,2,9): H=3, E=7, A=2, R=9, resulting in 3729[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: If '+' means 'x', '-' means '+' and 'x' means '-', what will be the value of 5+4-18*3?
questions.explanation: Replacing symbols according to the given rules: 5 * 4 + 18 - 3 = 20 + 18 - 3 = 38 - 3 = 35 (Note: Options reflect standard evaluation; closest matching option evaluated based on expression mapping)[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Find the missing character in the following question: (Figure shows an 8-way directional star with numbers at the tips: top=49, top-right=64, right=1, bottom-right=4, bottom=9, bottom-left=16, left=25, top-left=?)
questions.explanation: The numbers follow a square sequence around the center: 1^2=1, 2^2=4, 3^2=9, 4^2=16, 5^2=25, 6^2=36, 7^2=49, 8^2=64. The missing value corresponding to 6^2 is 36[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: In which year was the 'Planning Commission' set up in India?
questions.explanation: The Planning Commission of India was set up by a Cabinet resolution in March 1950[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Which of the following is chemical formula of Bleaching Powder?
questions.explanation: Bleaching powder is chemically known as calcium oxychloride with the formula Ca(OCl)Cl[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: National Education Day is celebrated on the birthday of
questions.explanation: National Education Day in India is celebrated on November 11 every year, commemorating the birth anniversary of Maulana Abul Kalam Azad[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: The binary system of computer uses powers of
questions.explanation: The binary number system operates in base 2, using powers of 2[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Which of the following aqueous solutions will turn blue litmus to red?
questions.explanation: Sulphur dioxide is an acidic oxide when dissolved in water, which turns blue litmus paper red[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Which of the following pollutant gases is not produced both naturally and as result of industrial activity?
questions.explanation: Chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) are purely synthetic man-made industrial compounds and are not produced naturally[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: 'Synectics' is the method used for catering to which category of children?
questions.explanation: Synectics is a problem-solving methodology that stimulates creative thinking and is used for creative children[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Where is situated the capital of Myanmar?
questions.explanation: Naypyitaw is the capital city of Myanmar[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: The first Indian Governor-General of independent India was
questions.explanation: Chakravarti Rajagopalachari was the first and last Indian Governor-General of independent India[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Mahatma Gandhi's Champaran Movement was for which of the following?
questions.optionB: Solving the problems of indigo workers
questions.optionD: Maintaining the unity of Hindu Society
questions.explanation: The Champaran Satyagraha of 1917 was launched to address the grievances of indigo sharecroppers against oppressive Tinkathia system[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: The average of three consecutive odd numbers is 12 more than one third of the first of these numbers. What is the last of the three numbers?
questions.explanation: Let the three consecutive odd numbers be x, x+2, and x+4. Their average is x+2. According to the question, x+2 = x/3 + 12, which gives x = 15. Therefore, the three numbers are 15, 17, and 19, so the last number is 19 (Option C).

questions.questionText: Rs. 7,500 is to be divided among A, B and C such that A's share to B's share is in the ratio 5:2 and B's share to C's share is in the ratio 7:13. How much will B receive?
questions.explanation: A:B = 35:14, B:C = 14:26. Combined ratio A:B:C = 35:14:26. Total parts = 75. B's share = (14/75) * 7500 = Rs. 1,400[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: The diagonal of a square is 4√2 cm. The diagonal of another square whose area is double that of the first square is
questions.explanation: Area of first square = d^2 / 2 = (4√2)^2 / 2 = 16. Area of second square = 32. Its diagonal = √(2 * Area) = √(64) = 8 cm[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: A train 100 m long is running at a speed of 30 km/hr. The time (in second) in which it passes a man standing on the railway platform is
questions.explanation: Speed = 30 * (5/18) = 25/3 m/s. Time = Distance / Speed = 100 / (25/3) = 12 seconds[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: If θ is positive acute angle and 3(sec^2 θ + tan^2 θ) = 5, then the value of cos 2θ is
questions.explanation: Solving 3(sec^2 θ + tan^2 θ) = 5 gives tan^2 θ = 1/3 => θ = 30°. Then cos 2θ = cos 60° = 1/2[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not used as a coolant in a nuclear reactor?
questions.explanation: Heavy water is primarily used as a moderator (though sometimes as coolant, water/heavy water/sodium/CO2 are coolants, but let's check standard categorization where heavy water is standard moderator)[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: The Provincial Governments were constituted under the Act of
questions.explanation: Provincial autonomy and provincial governments were established under the Government of India Act, 1935[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: The highest coal-producing country in the world is in which of the following?
questions.explanation: China is the world's largest coal producer[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Amritsar and Shimla are almost on the same latitude, but their climate difference is due to
questions.explanation: Altitude differences cause temperature and climate variations between Amritsar and Shimla[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Who is the constitutional head of the State Governments?
questions.explanation: The Governor is the constitutional head of each state in India[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: The product of two positive integers is 2048 and one of them is twice the other. Then the smaller of the numbers is
questions.explanation: Let numbers be x and 2x. x * 2x = 2048 => 2x^2 = 2048 => x^2 = 1024 => x = 32[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: If √3 = 1.732 is given, then the value of (2+√3)/(2-√3) is
The LCM of two numbers is 1820 and their HCF is 26. If one number is 130, then the other number is
questions.explanation: Other number = (LCM * HCF) / Given number = (1820 * 26) / 130 = 364[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: If 120 is 20% of a number, then 120% of that number will be
If the successive discounts are given as 20%, 10% and 5%, then the single equivalent discount is
questions.explanation: Remaining multiplier = 0.80 * 0.90 * 0.95 = 0.684. Equivalent discount = 1 - 0.684 = 0.316 or 31.6%[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Who is the winner of 46th National Women Chess Championship title, held on July 2019?
questions.explanation: Bhakti Kulkarni won the 46th National Women Chess Championship in 2019[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: At present the Vice-President of India is
questions.explanation: At the time of the exam (2020), M. Venkaiah Naidu was Vice-President, but among the options or context 'None of them' applies depending on current perspective, or M. Venkaiah Naidu (Option C)[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: The National Initiative for School Heads' and Teachers' Holistic Advancement (NISHTHA) teachers' training programme was launched on
questions.explanation: NISHTHA was launched on August 22, 2019[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: According to World Bank, which position is taken by India, among the largest economy in the Global GDP Ranking, 2018?
questions.explanation: India ranked seventh largest economy by nominal GDP in 2018 according to the World Bank[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Who has submitted the report for Draft of National Education Policy, 2019 on May 31, 2019?
questions.explanation: The draft NEP 2019 committee was headed by Dr. K. Kasturirangan[cite: 9].

questions.questionText:
Which option will take place of (?) in the following letter pattern?
BXF, DVI, FTL, HRO, ?
questions.explanation: 1st letters: B, D, F, H -> J (+2). 2nd letters: X, V, T, R -> P (-2). 3rd letters: F, I, L, O -> R (+3). Result: JPR[cite: 9].

questions.questionText:
Which number will take place of (?) in the following series?
144, 100, 64, ?, 16, 4
questions.explanation: Squares in descending order: 12^2=144, 10^2=100, 8^2=64, 6^2=36, 4^2=16, 2^2=4. Missing is 36[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: How many triangles are there in the following figure? (Figure shows a large triangle divided horizontally into 3 sections and vertically down the middle into 2 halves, forming 6 smaller quadrilateral/triangular compartments with cross lines)
questions.explanation: Counting all individual and combined triangles in the divided triangular grid yields 15 triangles[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: If 'Rajdoot' is coded as 'Car', 'Car' as 'Aeroplane', 'Aeroplane' as 'Train', 'Train' as 'Bus', then by which vehicle can you reach your destination in least time?
questions.explanation: The fastest vehicle is Aeroplane, and Aeroplane is coded as 'Train'. Thus, you reach in least time by 'Train'[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: If BLADE is coded in a symbolic language as SPTFA, then how will BALE be coded?
questions.explanation: Mapping letters from BLADE -> SPTFA for corresponding positions yields BALE -> STPA[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: What is the full form of USB as used in computer related activities?
questions.explanation: USB stands for Universal Serial Bus[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Gandhi-Irwin Pact took place in
questions.explanation: The Gandhi-Irwin Pact was signed on March 5, 1931[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Who was the father of Indian Renaissance?
questions.explanation: Raja Rammohan Roy is hailed as the father of the Indian Renaissance[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: One nautical mile is equal to
questions.explanation: One nautical mile equals exactly 1.852 kilometers[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Who was the Prime Minister of England at the time when India got independence?
questions.explanation: Clement Attlee was the Prime Minister of the United Kingdom when India gained independence in 1947[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Which article of the Constitution of India is related to the Right to Education?
questions.explanation: Article 21A of the Indian Constitution provides for free and compulsory education of all children in the age group of 6 to 14 years[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: For which word, has the letter 'G' been used in '2G spectrum'?
questions.explanation: In 2G, 'G' stands for Generation[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Mendel's principle of inheritance is based on
questions.explanation: Gregor Mendel's principles of heredity are based on sexual reproduction experiments involving pea plants[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Which component of plants receives stimulus for flowering?
questions.explanation: Leaves perceive the photoperiodic stimulus (photoperiodism) responsible for flowering in plants[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: 'Do or Die' is associated with the movement
questions.explanation: Mahatma Gandhi gave the slogan 'Do or Die' during the Quit India Movement in 1942[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Which of the following is/are word processing software?
questions.explanation: All listed options (Word Perfect, Easy Word, MS Word) are word processing software applications[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: To perform I/O operations in CPP, we must use ________ header file.
questions.explanation: In standard C++, `<iostream.h>` (or `<iostream>`) is required for standard input/output streams like cin and cout[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Ctrl + N is used to
questions.explanation: Ctrl + N is the standard shortcut to create a new document in MS Office[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: CPP keywords are also called
questions.explanation: C++ keywords are reserved words with predefined meanings in the language[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: What are inserted as cross-reference in Word?
questions.explanation: Cross-references in MS Word are inserted as field codes (Word fields) that dynamically update[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not the Section Break Option?
questions.explanation: Section break options include Next Page, Continuous, Even Page, and Odd Page; 'Previous Page' is not a section break option[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: DBMS stands for
questions.explanation: DBMS stands for Database Management System[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: By default, on which page the header or the footer is printed?
questions.explanation: By default, headers and footers appear on every page of a document[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Which operator has highest precedence in */%?
questions.explanation: Multiplication (*), Division (/), and Modulus (%) operators all share the exact same level of operator precedence[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Ctrl + G executes
questions.optionA: Open Paragraph Dialog box activating Goto Tab
questions.optionB: Open Page Setup Dialog box activating Goto Tab
questions.optionC: Open Find and Replace Dialog box with activating Goto Tab
questions.explanation: Ctrl + G opens the Find and Replace dialog box with the 'Go To' tab active in MS Word[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: What is a Firewall in Computer Network?
questions.optionB: An operating system of Computer Network
questions.optionC: A system designed to prevent unauthorized access
questions.explanation: A firewall is a network security system designed to monitor and prevent unauthorized access[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: The IETF standards of documents are called
questions.explanation: IETF standards documents are published as RFCs (Request for Comments)[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Which data communication method is used to transmit the data over a serial communication link?
questions.explanation: Serial communication links can utilize simplex, half-duplex, or full-duplex transmission modes depending on hardware[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: What is the minimum header size of an IP packet?
questions.explanation: The minimum header size of an IPv4 packet is 20 bytes[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Routing table of a router keeps track of
questions.optionC: Distributed IP addresses to network devices
questions.optionD: Routes to use for forwarding data to its destination
questions.explanation: A router's routing table maintains paths and routes to forward data packets toward their destination[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not External Security Threats?
questions.explanation: Back-door threats are generally internal or planted vulnerabilities within the system/code architecture[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: What is the IP Address range of APIPA?
questions.explanation: APIPA (Automatic Private IP Addressing) allocates addresses in the range 169.254.0.1 to 169.254.255.255[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not the possible ways of data exchange?
questions.explanation: Multiplexing is a technique to combine multiple signals, not a primary mode of data exchange direction like simplex/duplex[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: The management of data flow between computers or devices or between nodes in a network is called
questions.explanation: Flow control manages the rate of data transmission between two nodes to prevent a fast sender from overwhelming a slow receiver[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: What does the port number in a TCP connection specify?
questions.optionA: It specifies the communication process on the two-end systems
questions.optionB: It specifies the quality of the data & connection
questions.optionC: It specifies the size of data
questions.explanation: Port numbers identify specific application processes running on end systems[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: ________ is a basic data type.
questions.explanation: Integer (Int) is a fundamental built-in basic data type[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Which option can be used to set custom timing for slides in a presentation?
questions.explanation: Rehearsal allows recording and setting custom slide timings in presentation software[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Variables which can be accessed inside a module of the program is called
questions.explanation: Local variables are restricted in scope to the module or function in which they are declared[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Which key can be used to view slide show?
questions.explanation: F5 starts a slide show from the beginning in MS PowerPoint[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: To store character or text data we need
questions.explanation: String variables are designed specifically to store characters and text data[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: How can we stop a slide show?
questions.explanation: Pressing the Escape (Esc) key terminates an ongoing slide show[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Power Point can display data from which of the following add-in software of MS office?
questions.explanation: PowerPoint integrates with various MS Office add-ins including Organization Charts, Photo Albums, and Equation Editors[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: The spelling dialog box can be involved by choosing spelling from ________ menu.
questions.explanation: The spelling check utility is traditionally found under the Tools menu in classic office suites[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Which one is a primary key in a bank customer table?
questions.explanation: Account number uniquely identifies a customer record within a bank database table[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Power Point slide can have
questions.explanation: PowerPoint slides support diverse multimedia content including text, graphs, shapes, and clipart[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Right clicking on something in word
questions.optionB: is nothing but the right mouse button is there for left handed people
questions.explanation: Right-clicking opens a context menu or shortcut list tailored to the selected item[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: >= is a/an
questions.explanation: '>=' is a relational comparison operator[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: The autocorrect tool
questions.optionB: displays words with the same or similar meaning
questions.optionC: checks the grammar in the document
questions.optionD: checks for misspelled words as you type and correct them as defined
questions.explanation: AutoCorrect automatically detects common typos and replaces misspelled words as you type[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Which is encapsulated in a class?
questions.explanation: A class encapsulates member functions (methods) and data members (variables) together[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: To display hyperlink field in a Word document, you can press the
questions.explanation: Shift + F9 toggles field codes on and off for the selected field in Word[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Which is an Abstract data type?
questions.explanation: Classes serve as user-defined Abstract Data Types (ADTs) in object-oriented programming[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: To cut or copy text you must first
questions.optionB: First highlight the text and click the Copy or Cut command from edit menu
questions.explanation: Text must be highlighted or selected before applying cut or copy commands[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Which is correct for inheritance?
questions.explanation: 'Cat' is a specialized type of 'Animal', representing a classic 'is-a' inheritance relationship[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: The command Cross reference is available in ________ menu.
questions.explanation: Cross-reference commands are located under the Insert menu in word processors[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Column or Field of a table is called
questions.explanation: In relational database terminology, a column or field is referred to as an Attribute[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: TCP/IP is a
questions.explanation: TCP/IP is a foundational suite of communication protocols used across the internet[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: OSI stands for
questions.explanation: OSI stands for Open Systems Interconnection[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: The Internet was originally a project of which agency?
questions.explanation: The Internet originated as ARPANET, a project funded by the US Department of Defense's Advanced Research Projects Agency (ARPA)[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: HTML is used to create
questions.explanation: HTML is the standard markup language used to create web pages[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: The computer jargon www, stands for
questions.explanation: www stands for World Wide Web (Note: Option D corrects minor OCR typo in options)[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: A website's front page/main page is called
questions.explanation: The main landing page of a website is known as its Home Page[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Full form of HTML is
questions.explanation: HTML stands for HyperText Markup Language[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Computer Network is
questions.optionA: Collection of hardware components and computers
questions.explanation: A computer network involves interconnected computers sharing resources and hardware components over communication channels[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Protocols are
questions.optionA: Agreements on how communication components and DTEs are to communicate
questions.optionB: Logical communication channels for transferring data
questions.optionC: Physical communication channels used for transferring data
questions.explanation: Protocols define standard rules and agreements for data communication between devices[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Two devices are in network if
questions.optionA: a process in one device is able to exchange information with a process in another device
questions.optionB: a process is running on both devices
questions.optionC: PIDs of the processes running of different devices are same
questions.explanation: Devices are networked if processes on them can successfully exchange information[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: A high quality CAD system uses which of the following for printing, drawing and graphs?
questions.explanation: Digital plotters are specialized output devices used in CAD systems for high-quality vector drawings and graphs[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Which of the following is not an input device?
questions.explanation: COM (Computer Output to Microfilm) is an output device that records computer data onto microscopic film[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: The accuracy of the floating-point numbers representable in two 16-bit words of a computer is approximately
questions.explanation: Standard 32-bit (two 16-bit words) single-precision floating-point representation yields approximately 6 to 7 decimal digits of precision[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: A CPU contains
questions.optionA: a card reader and a printing device
questions.optionB: an analytical engine and a control unit
questions.optionC: a control unit and an arithmetic logic unit
questions.optionD: an arithmetic logic unit and a card reader
questions.explanation: The core components of a CPU are the Control Unit (CU) and the Arithmetic Logic Unit (ALU)[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: In most IBM PCs, the CPU, the device drives, memory expansion slots and active components are mounted on a single board. What is the name of this board?
questions.explanation: The main printed circuit board in a computer containing the CPU and memory slots is called the Motherboard[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Magnetic disks are the most popular medium for
questions.explanation: Magnetic disks provide direct (random) access to stored data blocks[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: A technique used by codes to convert an analog signal into a digital bit stream is known as
questions.explanation: Pulse Code Modulation (PCM) is the standard method used to convert an analog signal into a digital binary bit stream[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Regarding a VDU, which statement is more correct?
questions.explanation: A Visual Display Unit (VDU) functions fundamentally as an external peripheral device[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: A modern electronic computer is a machine that is meant for
questions.optionB: Input, storage, manipulation and outputting of data
questions.explanation: A modern computer is broadly defined as an automatic electronic machine for input, storage, manipulation, and output of data[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: When was vacuum tube invented?
questions.explanation: The thermionic vacuum tube (Audion) was invented by Lee de Forest in 1906[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: The main electronic component used in first generation computers was
questions.explanation: First-generation computers relied primarily on vacuum tubes and thermionic valves[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: A dumb terminal has
questions.explanation: A dumb terminal consists only of a keyboard and a screen with no independent processing capabilities[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: One millisecond is
questions.explanation: One millisecond equals one-thousandth (1/1000) of a second[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Modern computers are very reliable but they are not
questions.explanation: Computers are extremely reliable and fast, but they are not infallible (they can make errors due to faulty programming or bad data)[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Which of the following was a special purpose computer?
questions.explanation: Atanasoff-Berry Computer (ABC) was built specifically to solve systems of linear algebraic equations, making it a special-purpose computer[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: SMPS stands for
questions.explanation: SMPS stands for Switched-Mode Power Supply[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Which of the following storage devices can store maximum amount of data?
questions.explanation: Among the options, Hard Disks offer significantly higher storage capacities than floppies or CDs[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Which computer was considered the first electronic computer until 1973 when court invalidated the patent?
questions.explanation: ENIAC was widely regarded as the first electronic computer until the landmark court ruling in 1973 invalidating the ENIAC patent in favor of Atanasoff's ABC[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: A physical connection between the microprocessor memory and other parts of the microcomputer is known as
questions.explanation: The physical collection of wires connecting memory and the microprocessor to transmit memory locations is the Address bus[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: High density, double sided floppy disks could store ________ of data.
questions.explanation: Standard high-density 3.5-inch double-sided floppy disks stored 1.44 MB of data[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: You can auto fit the width of column by
questions.optionA: double clicking on the column name on column header
questions.optionB: double clicking on the cell pointer in worksheet
questions.optionC: double clicking on column right border on column header
questions.optionD: double clicking on the column left border of column header
questions.explanation: Double-clicking the right border of a column header in spreadsheet applications auto-fits the column width[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: MS Excel provides the default value ________ for step in Fill Series dialog box.
questions.explanation: The default step value in the Fill Series dialog box in Excel is 1[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Ctrl + D shortcut key in Excel will
questions.optionB: apply double underline for the active cell
questions.explanation: In MS Excel, Ctrl + D fills down the contents of the top cell of a selection into the cells below[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: The shortcut key Ctrl + R is used in Excel to
questions.optionA: Right align the content of cell
questions.optionB: Remove the cell contents of selected cells
questions.optionC: Fill the selection with active cells to the right
questions.explanation: Ctrl + R fills the content of the leftmost cell in a selection to the right across selected cells[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: The command Edit >> Fill Across Worksheet is active only when
questions.explanation: Fill Across Worksheet is only enabled when multiple worksheets are simultaneously selected[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Which of the following series type is not valid for Fill Series dialog box?
questions.explanation: Valid Excel fill series types include Linear, Growth, Date, and AutoFill; 'Time' is not a separate primary series type option[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Which of the following you can paste selectively using Paste Special Command?
questions.explanation: Paste Special in Excel allows selectively pasting formulas, formats, validations, comments, and values[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Paste Special allows some operation while you paste to new cell. Which of the following operations is valid?
questions.explanation: Paste Special mathematical operations include Add, Subtract, Multiply, and Divide[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Edit >> Delete command
questions.optionA: deletes the content of a cell
questions.explanation: Edit -> Delete removes the selected cells entirely and shifts surrounding cells, whereas Clear removes contents/formats[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: To remove the content of selected cells you must issue ________ command.
questions.explanation: To clear only the contents of selected cells without shifting cells, Edit -> Clear -> Contents is used[cite: 9].

questions.explanation: Ctrl + M is the standard shortcut key to insert a new slide in MS PowerPoint[cite: 9].

questions.explanation: Every primary key is technically a super key (and a candidate key, but super key is the broader encompassing concept in options)[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Which of the following methods can insert a new slide in current presentation?
questions.optionA: Right click on the Slide panel and choose New Slide
questions.optionB: From Insert menu choose New Slide
questions.optionC: Click on New Slide button on toolbar
questions.explanation: New slides can be inserted via the toolbar button, Insert menu, or right-clicking the slide panel[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Android is a/an
questions.explanation: Android is a mobile operating system developed by Google[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: What is the best way to create another copy of a slide?
questions.optionA: Click the slide then press Ctrl+A and paste in new slide
questions.optionB: From Insert Menu choose Duplicate Slide
questions.optionC: Redo everything on a new slide that you had done on previous slide
questions.explanation: The most efficient way to copy a slide in PowerPoint is using the 'Duplicate Slide' command from the Insert or context menu[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Float is a/an
questions.explanation: Float is a fundamental primitive data type used to represent floating-point (decimal) numbers[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: From which menu you can access Picture, Test Box, Chart etc.?
questions.explanation: The Insert menu allows users to add objects like pictures, text boxes, and charts into documents[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Term 'Data' refers to ________ and information refers to ________.
questions.explanation: Data refers to raw, unprocessed facts, while information refers to processed, organized, and structured data[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: To insert slide numbers
questions.optionA: Insert a text box and select Insert >> Page Number
questions.optionB: Insert a text box and select Insert >> Number >> Page Number
questions.optionD: Insert a new text box and select Insert >> Slide Number
questions.explanation: Slide numbers are inserted via the Insert -> Slide Number command[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: By default Excel provides 3 worksheets. You need only two of them. How will you delete the third one?
questions.optionA: Right click on Sheet Tab of third sheet and choose Delete from the context menu
questions.optionB: Click on Sheet 3 and from Edit menu choose Delete
questions.explanation: Worksheets can be deleted either by right-clicking the sheet tab or via the Edit menu delete option[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Which of the following actions removes a sheet from workbook?
questions.optionA: Select the sheet, then choose Edit >> Delete Sheet
questions.optionB: Select the sheet then choose Format >> Sheet >> Hide
questions.explanation: Edit -> Delete Sheet removes a worksheet, whereas Hide only conceals it[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: While finding and replacing some data in Excel, which of the following statements is valid?
questions.optionA: You can find and replace within the sheet or workbook
questions.optionB: Excel does not have option to match case for find
questions.explanation: Excel allows finding and replacing text across an active worksheet or an entire workbook[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Rounding errors can occur
questions.optionA: when you use multiplication, division, or exponentiation in a formula
questions.optionB: when you use addition and subtraction in a formula
questions.optionC: because excel uses hidden decimal places in computation
questions.optionD: when you show the results of formulas with different decimal places that the calculated results
questions.explanation: Rounding discrepancies can surface when displayed decimal places differ from the precision stored during internal calculations[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: You can copy data or formulas
questions.optionA: With the copy, paste and cut commands on the edit menu
questions.optionB: With commands on the shortcut menu
questions.optionC: With buttons on the standard toolbars
questions.explanation: Data and formulas can be copied via edit menus, shortcut right-click menus, or standard toolbar buttons[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: You cannot link excel worksheet data to a word document
questions.optionC: With the copy and paste special commands
questions.optionD: With the copy and paste buttons on the standard toolbar
questions.explanation: Standard paste buttons alone just copy static data without establishing a live link; Paste Special (Paste Link) is required for dynamic linking[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Which of the following is a popular DOS based spreadsheet package?
questions.explanation: Lotus 1-2-3 was a highly popular spreadsheet application developed for MS-DOS systems[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: An excel workbook is a collection of
questions.explanation: An Excel workbook serves as a container file holding worksheets and chart sheets[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: Excel files have a default extension of
questions.explanation: Classic Excel workbook files possess the default extension .xls (and .xlsx in modern versions)[cite: 9].

questions.questionText: You can use the Format Painter multiple times before you turn it off by
questions.optionA: You can use the format painter button only one time when you click it
questions.optionB: Double clicking the format painter button
questions.optionC: Pressing the Ctrl key and clicking the format painter button
questions.optionD: Pressing the Alt key and clicking the format painter button
questions.explanation: Double-clicking the Format Painter button locks it on so it can be applied repeatedly across multiple cells[cite: 9].
